access_boundary: This record represents the DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 official release checkpoint (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, 1.65T total, 49B active, 1M context, speculative-decoding module attached) and its deepseek-v4-pro API model ID, which serves this release with no migration; DeepSeek reversed the planned September routing of the ID to V4.1 Flash and continues serving V4 Pro. The preview checkpoint repository, the Base sibling, the dated 0423 snapshot, the V4 Flash siblings, the V4.1 Flash successor line, and community quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: MIT-licensed 1.65T official-release weights with mirrors and standard Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and NIM paths
First-party DeepSeek API with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, 1M context, and 384K maximum output plus documented NVIDIA NIM hosting for the exact checkpoint
tradeoffs: Checkpoint scale keeps single-node self-hosting heavy despite efficient hybrid attention
The preview-to-official transition replaced the weights checkpoint and dropped the Jinja chat template for encoding-folder scripts
